Title: Manoj and the Family

Cast

1. Manoj - 34 years, son
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
2. Kavita - 32 years, daughter
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Ajay - 27 years, friend
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
4. Anita - 31 years, friend
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
5. Neeta - 56 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The hospital ward - white beds, a drip stand
3. The office - desks, computers, a glass wall

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Kavita stands in the courtyard. Manoj, Neeta and Ajay stand near her.]

Ajay: "Aunty, what's the plan today?"

[Kavita washes clothes in a bucket.]

Kavita: "Mom, are you okay?"

[Manoj dances at his sister's wedding.]

Manoj (happily): "That's great!"

[Manoj showers flower petals on the couple.]

Manoj: "Careful!"

[Manoj spins cotton on the spinning wheel.]

Ajay: "This is amazing!"

Scene 2: The hospital ward - Day

[Manoj stands in the ward. Neeta, Kavita and Ajay stand near him.]

Ajay: "Kavita, look over here."

[Manoj folds his hands and prays for the departed soul.]

Manoj: "I'm ready!"

[Manoj walks to the reception desk and asks for the doctor.]

Kavita: "That was fun!"

Scene 3: The office - Day

[Manoj stands in the office. Neeta, Ajay and Anita stand near him.]

Anita: "Manoj, look over here."

[Manoj presses the lift button and waits.]

Manoj (happily): "One more time!"

[Manoj checks his watch impatiently.]

Ajay: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
